flashcard_questions.q: What does the Arithmetic Logic Unit inside the CPU do?
flashcard_questions.a: It carries out arithmetic and logic operations.

flashcard_questions.q: Which part of the CPU decodes instructions and sends out control signals?
What is a register inside the CPU?
flashcard_questions.a: A tiny, extremely fast storage location that holds one value or address.

flashcard_questions.q: What is stored in the cache inside a processor?
flashcard_questions.a: Copies of the data and instructions the CPU uses most often.
A design where program instructions and data share the same memory.

flashcard_questions.q: Why can a Von Neumann processor only handle one instruction at a time?
flashcard_questions.a: Instructions and data share one memory and one route to the CPU.

flashcard_questions.q: Which register holds the address of the next instruction to be fetched?
Which register holds the address the CPU is about to read from or write to?
Which register holds data just read from memory, or about to be written to it?
Which register stores the result of a calculation carried out by the ALU?
Which stage sits between fetch and execute in the processor cycle?
What happens to the Program Counter during the fetch stage?
flashcard_questions.a: It is increased by one so it points to the following instruction.

flashcard_questions.q: What does the control unit do during the decode stage?
flashcard_questions.a: It works out what the instruction means and which parts are needed.

flashcard_questions.q: What happens in the execute stage of the cycle?
flashcard_questions.a: The instruction is carried out, for example the ALU performing a calculation.
